Soldering the EPAD to the ground of the base board is not a must, however, it can optimize thermal performance.
If you choose to solder it, please apply the correct amount of soldering paste.
Too much soldering paste may increase the gap between the module and the baseboard.
As a result, the adhesion between other pins and the baseboard may be poor.
